subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt the four-PR shadow-lineage architecture as the canonical long-term fork-accounting path, and if so how should the overlapping identity/cache fixes in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 be incorporated?
rationale: Both approaches address the same user-visible overcount through materially different architecture, and automated review cannot determine whether the repository should permanently accept the larger accounting subsystem or prefer the narrower incremental model.

options.title: Adopt the lineage stack
options.body: Approve the four-PR architecture, reconcile the narrow identity/cache behavior into it, and keep legacy authoritative until promotion evidence is complete.

options.title: Prefer the narrow fix
options.body: Land the bounded identity/cache correction and defer the larger lineage subsystem until maintainers want a permanent second accounting engine.

options.title: Pause both paths
options.body: Retain current Phase 1 containment while requesting broader corpus and upgrade evidence before selecting a permanent design.

recommendation.title: Adopt the lineage stack
recommendation.body: Approve the four-PR architecture, reconcile the narrow identity/cache behavior into it, and keep legacy authoritative until promotion evidence is complete.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice sets the repository's long-term accounting architecture and landing order for overlapping open pull requests.
